tasks.title: Google Search
tasks.description: Search Google for ranked web pages, titles, URLs and snippets. Build localized SERP snapshots for research and comparison. CLI and MCP via the paid FlashData API.

tasks.title: Google News
tasks.description: Search Google News for articles, publishers, date labels and source links. Turn a topic into a traceable news briefing. CLI and MCP via the paid FlashData API.

tasks.title: Google Images
tasks.description: Find Google Images results with image URLs, dimensions and original source pages. Build an attributable image research inventory. CLI and MCP via the paid FlashData API.

tasks.title: Google Shopping
tasks.description: Search Google Shopping for products, merchants and price labels. Collect comparable offer snapshots with product IDs and source links. CLI and MCP via the paid FlashData API.

tasks.title: Google Video Search
tasks.description: Search Google Videos across websites. Retrieve video titles, links, sources and available durations for a cross-site video inventory. CLI and MCP via the paid FlashData API.

tasks.title: Google Places
tasks.description: Search for local businesses and places with addresses, available ratings and review counts. Build location-specific research shortlists. CLI and MCP via the paid FlashData API.

tasks.title: YouTube Search
tasks.description: Search YouTube videos by keyword with date, duration, feature and sorting filters. Return video IDs, channels and available statistics. CLI and MCP via the paid FlashData API.

tasks.title: YouTube Extended Search
tasks.description: Search larger YouTube video result sets, with up to 700 requested results. Map recurring channels and topics from structured video records. CLI and MCP via the paid FlashData API.

tasks.title: YouTube Metadata
tasks.description: Read YouTube video details, descriptions, statistics and available chapters. Inspect formats or prepare timestamped chapter navigation. CLI and MCP via the paid FlashData API.

tasks.title: YouTube Transcript
tasks.description: Retrieve available YouTube transcript text with start and end timestamps. Build cited summaries, searchable notes and transcript exports. CLI and MCP via the paid FlashData API.

tasks.title: YouTube Captions
tasks.description: Retrieve YouTube uploader captions with timed segments. Prepare subtitle exports and inspect the language and caption-track type. CLI and MCP via the paid FlashData API.

tasks.title: YouTube Creative Commons License Metadata
tasks.description: Inspect a YouTube video’s Creative Commons license classification. Record the returned license-label signal for a separate rights review. CLI and MCP via the paid FlashData API.

tasks.title: YouTube Channel Data
tasks.description: Read a YouTube channel profile and recent videos by handle. Capture channel identifiers and a bounded recent-upload inventory. CLI and MCP via the paid FlashData API.

tasks.title: YouTube Autocomplete
tasks.description: Get YouTube search suggestions for a query prefix, language and region. Build keyword idea sheets from actual autocomplete phrases. CLI and MCP via the paid FlashData API.

tasks.title: YouTube Download to Cloud Storage
tasks.description: Deliver YouTube video, audio or clips to your own S3 or other supported cloud storage. Track asynchronous delivery and its output manifest. CLI and MCP via the paid FlashData API.
